intro: Before your guide goes into the post, fresh readers read every word of it for sense, one part each, looking for a real word where another belongs, like "oily" for "old" in your hypnosis guide. To test them, I hid nine errors of that kind in their copies, and they found eight. The ninth, "wealth" where "warmth" belonged, was in the last part, and a second reader of that part missed it too, so there their silence counts for a little less. Everything they found is in your own words, so nothing changes without you: %(slip)d cards are typos or slips, %(meaning)d may not be the word you meant, %(form)d make your spelling and dashes match, %(ask)d is a question, and %(leave)d are ones I'd leave.
more: A spell check under the read found nothing else to fix: every word it didn't know is a name, a term, or one of your own words.
Approve, Reject or Revise each card, with a comment if you like. Your answers save as you click. When you're done, tell me in the chat, and I'll put them in.
